intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Momentum and Collisions — linear momentum, impulse and the impulse-momentum theorem, conservation of momentum, and elastic and inelastic collisions. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`). BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so the momentum work stays one-dimensional with a sign convention, but the reasoning is held to AP Physics 1 rigor (this is AP Physics 1 Unit 4).

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand ($p = mv$, $F\Delta t = \Delta p$, and $p_i = p_f$ with round numbers). Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.

The bank is tranche 1; more items will follow.
